title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs  (Part One)

series.title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs  (Part One)

fullText.simplified:
第18章、凤雏先生

    晚上，又冷又累的蒋干在雪山里遇到了一间草房。
    他敲了敲门，门开了，是个男人，三十多岁的样子，个子不高，有点儿胖，眼睛很小，鼻子和嘴很大，长得很不好看。
    蒋干说：“你好，我太累了，能进来休息一下吗？”
    男人说：“当然可以，请进。”
    蒋干进去了，里面很暖和，灯光也很亮。他看到房间里放着很多书，都是兵书，兵书中间还放着一把刀。他越看越吃惊，心想这个人太特别了。
    男人看到他吃惊的样子，笑了笑，说：“这些都是我的书，我喜欢读书。”
    蒋干问：“你叫什么名字？”
    男人说：“我姓庞，叫庞统。”
    蒋干的眼睛大了，他在心里大叫一声：“我的天！是凤雏！”
    很久以前蒋干就听过一句话，“卧龙、凤雏，两人得一，可安天下。”它的意思是，只要得到“卧龙”和“凤雏”这两个人中的一个，就可以得到把国家变好的能力。“卧龙”说的是诸葛亮，“凤雏”说的就是庞统啊！
    蒋干不敢相信地问：“您就是凤雏先生？”
    庞统笑着说：“没错，是我。”
    蒋干的心跳得很厉害，高兴得脸都红了。他看着庞统，心里有了一个大胆的想法。
    这时候，在山外面热闹的江东城里，周瑜的院子里也在下雪。
    已经很晚了，周瑜还没有睡，他一直站在门外，看着山的方向。一个小兵走到他身边，说：“将军，外面太冷了，房间里面暖和，您进房间去吧。”
    周瑜听到了，但他没有动，还是看着山的方向。过了一会儿，他问：“雪这么大，蒋干能看到那间草房吗？”
    小兵听不懂周瑜的话：“哪间草房？将军您说什么？”
    周瑜没有看小兵，像是回答自己的问题，他说：“雪越大，天越冷，蒋干就越会相信他看到的。”
    小兵更听不懂了，但他知道蒋干这个人，他说：“将军，我现在就去山上把蒋干带过来，您要打要杀都可以。”
    周瑜终于笑了，他说：“不能打，也不能杀。江东想要打败曹操，还需要蒋干的帮助。”
    小兵不明白地问：“蒋干是曹操的人，他会帮我们？”
    周瑜看着山的那边说：“会的，因为我们有凤雏先生。”
    雪越下越大，周瑜在门外的风雪里站了一晚。他在等，等天亮，等一个答案——明天早上就会有答案。他相信，每个人都有明天，江东也还有明天。
fullText.traditional:
第18章、鳳雛先生

    晚上，又冷又累的蔣幹在雪山裡遇到了一間草房。
    他敲了敲門，門開了，是個男人，三十多歲的樣子，個子不高，有點兒胖，眼睛很小，鼻子和嘴很大，長得很不好看。
    蔣幹說：“你好，我太累了，能進來休息一下嗎？”
    男人說：“當然可以，請進。”
    蔣幹進去了，裡面很暖和，燈光也很亮。他看到房間裡放著很多書，都是兵書，兵書中間還放著一把刀。他越看越吃驚，心想這個人太特別了。
    男人看到他吃驚的樣子，笑了笑，說：“這些都是我的書，我喜歡讀書。”
    蔣幹問：“你叫什麼名字？”
    男人說：“我姓龐，叫龐統。”
    蔣幹的眼睛大了，他在心裡大叫一聲：“我的天！是鳳雛！”
    很久以前蔣幹就聽過一句話，“臥龍、鳳雛，兩人得一，可安天下。”它的意思是，只要得到“臥龍”和“鳳雛”這兩個人中的一個，就可以得到把國家變好的能力。“臥龍”說的是諸葛亮，“鳳雛”說的就是龐統啊！
    蔣幹不敢相信地問：“您就是鳳雛先生？”
    龐統笑著說：“沒錯，是我。”
    蔣幹的心跳得很厲害，高興得臉都紅了。他看著龐統，心裡有了一個大膽的想法。
    這時候，在山外面熱鬧的江東城裡，周瑜的院子裡也在下雪。
    已經很晚了，周瑜還沒有睡，他一直站在門外，看著山的方向。一個小兵走到他身邊，說：“將軍，外面太冷了，房間裡面暖和，您進房間去吧。”
    周瑜聽到了，但他沒有動，還是看著山的方向。過了一會兒，他問：“雪這麼大，蔣幹能看到那間草房嗎？”
    小兵聽不懂周瑜的話：“哪間草房？將軍您說什麼？”
    周瑜沒有看小兵，像是回答自己的問題，他說：“雪越大，天越冷，蔣幹就越會相信他看到的。”
    小兵更聽不懂了，但他知道蔣幹這個人，他說：“將軍，我現在就去山上把蔣幹帶過來，您要打要殺都可以。”
    周瑜終於笑了，他說：“不能打，也不能殺。江東想要打敗曹操，還需要蔣幹的幫助。”
    小兵不明白地問：“蔣幹是曹操的人，他會幫我們？”
    周瑜看著山的那邊說：“會的，因為我們有鳳雛先生。”
    雪越下越大，周瑜在門外的風雪裡站了一晚。他在等，等天亮，等一個答案——明天早上就會有答案。他相信，每個人都有明天，江東也還有明天。

sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bīng bù míng bai de wèn jiǎng gàn shì cáo cāo de rén tā huì bāng wǒ men
sentences.english: The soldier asked, confused, “Jiang Gan works for Cao Cao. Will he help us?”

sentences.simplified: 周瑜看着山的那边说：“会的，因为我们有凤雏先生。”
sentences.traditional: 周瑜看著山的那邊說：“會的，因為我們有鳳雛先生。”
sentences.pinyin: zhōu yú kàn zhe shān de nà bian shuō huì de yīn wèi wǒ men yǒu fèng chú xiān sheng
sentences.english: Zhou Yu looked at the other side of the mountain and said, “Yes, because we have Mr. Fledgling Phoenix.”

sentences.simplified: 雪越下越大，周瑜在门外的风雪里站了一晚。
sentences.traditional: 雪越下越大，周瑜在門外的風雪裡站了一晚。
sentences.pinyin: xuě yuè xià yuè dà zhōu yú zài mén wài de fēng xuě lǐ zhàn le yì wǎn
sentences.english: The snow fell heavier and heavier, and Zhou Yu stood outside the door in the wind and snow all night.

sentences.simplified: 他在等，等天亮，等一个答案——明天早上就会有答案。
sentences.traditional: 他在等，等天亮，等一個答案——明天早上就會有答案。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài děng děng tiān liàng děng yí ge dá àn míng tiān zǎo shang jiù huì yǒu dá àn
sentences.english: He was waiting, waiting for dawn, waiting for an answer—there would be an answer tomorrow morning.

sentences.simplified: 他相信，每个人都有明天，江东也还有明天。
sentences.traditional: 他相信，每個人都有明天，江東也還有明天。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiāng xìn měi ge rén dōu yǒu míng tiān jiāng dōng yě hái yǒu míng tiān
sentences.english: He believed that every person had a future, and Jiangdong also still had a future.

sentence_translations: Chapter 18: Mr. Fledgling Phoenix
At night, the cold and tired Jiang Gan came across a thatched cottage.
He knocked on the door, and the door opened. It was a man who looked to be in his thirties.
He was not tall, was a bit chubby, and had small eyes with a large nose and mouth. He was quite unattractive.
Jiang Gan said, “Hello, I am so tired. Can I come in and rest for a while?”
The man said, “Of course, please come in.”
Jiang Gan entered. It was very warm and brightly lit inside.
He saw that there were many books in the room, all of which were books on military strategy.
There was also a sword among the books on military strategy.
The more he looked, the more surprised he was. He thought to himself that this person was quite unusual.
The man saw his startled look, smiled, and said, “These are all my books. I like to read.”
Jiang Gan asked, “What is your name?”
The man said, “My surname is Pang, and my name is Pang Tong.”
Jiang Gan’s eyes widened. He said loudly to himself, “My goodness! It’s the Fledgling Phoenix!”
A long time ago, Jiang Gan had heard a saying:
“Crouching Dragon and Fledgling Phoenix, whoever obtains one of the two can bring peace to the world.”
It meant that if someone obtained one of Crouching Dragon or Fledgling Phoenix, they would get the ability to make the country better.
“Crouching Tiger” referred to Zhuge Liang, and “Fledgling Phoenix” referred to none other than Pang Tong!
Jiang Gan asked in disbelief, “You are Mr. Fledgling Phoenix?”
Pang Tong smiled and said, “That’s right, it’s me.”
Jiang Gan’s heart was pounding. He was so happy that his face turned red.
He looked at Pang Tong, and a bold idea appeared in his mind.
At this time, it was also snowing in Zhou Yu’s courtyard in the bustling city of Jiangdong outside of the mountains.
It was already very late, yet Zhou Yu had not yet gone to bed.
He had been standing outside the door the entire time, looking towards the mountains.
A soldier walked up to him and said, “General, it’s too cold outside.
It is warm in the room. Why don’t you go inside the room?”
Zhou Yu heard this but did not move. He was still looking towards the mountains.
After a while, he asked, “It’s snowing very hard. Will Jiang Gan be able to see that thatched cottage?”
The soldier did not understand what Zhou Yu meant: “Which thatched cottage? General, what did you say?”
Zhou Yu did not look at the soldier.
As if answering his own question, he said, “The heavier the snow and the colder the day, the more Jiang Gan will believe what he sees.”
The soldier was even more confused, but he knew who Jiang Gan was.
He said, “General, I will go to the mountains right now to bring Jiang Gan over.
You can flog him or kill him, whatever you wish.”
Zhou Yu finally smiled. He said, “We can’t flog him or kill him.
If Jiangdong wants to defeat Cao Cao, it still needs the help of Jiang Gan.”
The soldier asked, confused, “Jiang Gan works for Cao Cao. Will he help us?”
Zhou Yu looked at the other side of the mountain and said, “Yes, because we have Mr. Fledgling Phoenix.”
The snow fell heavier and heavier, and Zhou Yu stood outside the door in the wind and snow all night.
He was waiting, waiting for dawn, waiting for an answer—there would be an answer tomorrow morning.
He believed that every person had a future, and Jiangdong also still had a future.
